title: Make the search client latest-only
acceptanceCriteria: A search shows its results, with `status: "success"`
Starting a new search aborts the previous request's signal
An older response never overwrites a newer search's results, even when the request ignores its signal
A superseded search is never reported as an error, even when the request rejects with its own error instead of an `AbortError`
`cancel()` aborts the request in flight and returns to `status: "idle"` with no error, and stays idle even if that request still resolves
A search that takes longer than `timeoutMs` (default `TIMEOUT_MS`) has its request aborted, and ends with `status: "error"` and `error: "Search timed out"`
A real failure ends with `status: "error"` and the failure's own message
